description: How the system works, the operating workflow, AI agent roles and the glossary of terms

workflow.title: Six-stage workflow
workflow.secondary: Quy trình vận hành 6 giai đoạn

intro.lead: ADS-NOLIMIT AI OFFICE is the command center of a media & marketing company run by AI agents. You – the Owner – set the goal; the AI team plans, assigns, executes, reviews and reports, while every important decision still waits for your approval.
paragraphs: Every screen (Dashboard, Org Chart, 3D Virtual Office, Task Management…) reads from one single source of truth published by the backend, so numbers match everywhere and update in real time.
The interface uses Vietnamese as its primary language; English industry terms are always paired with their Vietnamese meaning. When a term is unfamiliar, look it up in the glossary below.

architecture.title: Hybrid Local + Cloud architecture
architecture.secondary: Kiến trúc kết hợp cục bộ và đám mây
architecture.body: The system has two layers. The orchestration layer (data, tasks, logs, approval rules) always runs on your machine. The AI model layer can run locally through Ollama, in the cloud through Anthropic Claude, or both, depending on the execution mode you pick in Settings.

local.title: Local layer
items: Backend that orchestrates work and stores all data
AI models running on the machine through Ollama (optional)

cloud.title: Cloud layer
items: Anthropic Claude models for deep reasoning
Ad platforms: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads
Storage, analytics, CRM and messaging services

bridge.title: Bridge
items: Connectors are granted one at a time
Every outbound command is written to the Activity Log
Spending and publishing must pass the Approval Center

architecture.caption: Orchestration data never leaves the local layer; only model calls and ad-platform commands cross the bridge.

items.title: Single source of truth
items.body: Every page reads the same data – no copies, no mismatched numbers.

items.title: The Owner always decides
items.body: Plans, budgets, content and publishing only run after you approve.

items.title: Transparent at every step
items.body: Each AI agent action appears in the Activity Log and the 3D office.

workflow.lead: Every request you send to the AI CEO passes through the same six stages. Each stage has one responsible role and one clear output.

receive.body: The AI CEO reads the request and clarifies goal, audience, budget and deadline; if something is missing it asks you in the chat.
receive.output: A confirmed request recorded in the system

plan.body: The AI CEO builds the master plan: strategy, channels, timeline and KPIs. The plan is sent to the Approval Center.
plan.output: A plan waiting for your approval

assign.body: The AI Project Manager breaks the plan into concrete tasks and assigns each to the right specialist by skill and current workload.
assign.output: A task list with assignees and due dates

execute.body: AI Specialists do the work using the connectors they have been granted; progress updates continuously on every screen.

review.body: The AI QA Reviewer checks quality, brand compliance and accuracy. Failed work goes back to Execute with comments.

report.body: The AI COO consolidates results, metrics and next steps into a report for the Owner.

roles.lead: Five AI roles form a complete organization that reports in layers, like a real company.

ai_ceo.summary: Receives your goals, sets strategy and coordinates the whole company.
duties: Clarifies requests and builds the master plan
Answers you in the AI CEO Command Center

ai_coo.summary: Keeps the machine running: tracks progress, resources and consolidates reports.

ai_project_manager.summary: Turns plans into concrete tasks and keeps them on schedule.

ai_specialist.summary: Hands-on specialists in each department: marketing, content, community, data, sales, tech.

ai_qa_reviewer.summary: The quality gate before anything reaches you or a customer.
duties: Returns work for revision when needed

roles.noHolders: No AI agent holds this role yet

quickstart.lead: The four actions you will use every day.

assign.title: Brief the AI CEO
steps: Open the AI CEO Command Center and type your goal, e.g. grow leads by 30% in 30 days.
Pick a priority and send. The AI CEO replies and drafts a plan summary.
Watch the plan move to the Approval Center for your decision.

approve.title: Approve or reject
steps: Go to the Approval Center – pending requests are listed first.
Read the summary, amount (if any) and the linked task.
Click Approve to execute now, or Reject with a note so the AI CEO revises the plan.

pause.title: Pause an agent
pause.secondary: Tạm dừng một nhân sự AI
steps: Open the AI Agents page or click a character in the 3D office.
In the detail drawer click Pause – the agent stops taking new work and its current task becomes Pending.
Click Resume when you want the agent back.

office.title: Read the 3D office
steps: Each room glows in its department color; a character at a desk is working, in the meeting room is planning.
The dot above a character is its status: green active, blue running, amber waiting, violet paused, red error.
Click a character to open its profile; use Focus Camera from any page to find it quickly.

items.q: Is company data sent to the cloud?
items.a: Orchestration data (tasks, approvals, logs) always stays on your machine. Only content that needs an AI model is sent out, and only in Cloud or Hybrid mode. In Local mode nothing leaves the machine.

items.q: Why are the numbers on the Dashboard and in the 3D office always identical?
items.a: Because every page reads from one single source of truth published by the backend and pushed in real time. No page keeps its own copy.

items.q: Can AI agents spend ad budget on their own?
items.a: No. Every spend, plan, piece of content and publish command must pass the Approval Center. Agents execute only after you click Approve.

items.q: Which execution mode should I choose?
items.a: Hybrid is the balanced choice for most businesses: routine work runs locally, quality-critical work goes to the cloud. Pick Local for absolute privacy, Cloud if your machine is weak and you need top quality.

items.q: Why do labels show both Vietnamese and English?
items.a: This is the system's language standard: Vietnamese is the primary label for instant understanding, the English term is attached so you grow familiar with industry vocabulary used by partners and ad platforms.

items.q: What happens when I reject a request?
items.a: The AI CEO reads your note, revises the plan and submits a new request. Related tasks stay Pending until a decision is made.

items.q: What if the connection to the backend drops?
items.a: The header shows a warning, the interface keeps the last data and reconnects automatically. You can also click Refresh data in Settings.
